tldr: Jupiter through the 4th house expands home, family, privacy, and emotional foundations.
body:
When Jupiter moves through your 4th house, it makes more room around home, family, privacy, memory, living space, roots, and what is happening behind closed doors. You may notice what is happening privately, what your home needs, or what old family and memory patterns are bringing into the present.

Hope, appetite, confidence, opportunity, and risk can all get bigger. It can help you say yes to something that gives your life more range.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for tending to the base of your life instead of only managing what other people can see.

The caution: Watch for taking on more than the situation, your schedule, or your judgment can hold. The risk is retreating so far inward that nothing gets named or handled.

Jupiter moves through this house for about a year. Let the opening be real, but keep your promises sized to the life you can actually live.
